audit.why: A ranged poke lane Quinn owns until Glacial Prison exists; the chart's Quinn 6/7 with Skill at level 6 matches the 43.55% stored in the file.
Spikes at Quinn 1-5, Sejuani 6, first item and two items are right and the level-6 spike is the genuine hinge.

audit.whatIsWrong: 1) The blind is attributed to Vault throughout ('Vault knocks you back and blinds you'; the full layer labels the ability 'Vault (Dash/Blind)'). Vault is a dash that damages, slows and briefly interrupts; the blind is Blinding Assault (Q). 2) The reason Vault beats Arctic Assault is never stated — Riot's text says Vault briefly interrupts its target, which is what cancels your charge. 3) A blind stops basic attacks only, so Winter's Wrath keeps applying Frost through it — the page implies the whole trade is dead. 4) Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, and Permafrost or Glacial Prison cancels it outright; absent entirely.
audit.why: The player is told to fear the wrong button, and the one free punish in the matchup — cancelling her ult channel — is missing.
audit.corrected: Blind moved to Blinding Assault (11s), Vault named as the interrupt (12s at rank 1), the blind scoped to autos, and the Behind Enemy Lines cancel stated.

edits.before: This lane is Quinn's until you have your ultimate, full stop. Her Harrier passive marks you constantly and every auto-attack trade she starts is free because Vault knocks you back and blinds you the moment you try to respond with Arctic Assault. Take W first, last-hit from range with Winter's Wrath ice shards, and never burn your Q into a Vault that is up — she will just flip you away, proc a Harrier mark on landing, and walk back to safety. Doran's Shield and Second Wind are mandatory; without them the chip damage adds up to a kill before level 6.
edits.after: This lane is Quinn's until you have your ultimate, full stop. Her Harrier passive marks you constantly and every trade she starts is free: Vault's dash briefly interrupts Arctic Assault mid-charge and drops her back at range, while Blinding Assault blanks the autos you meant to answer with. Take W first, last-hit from range with Winter's Wrath ice shards, and never burn your Q into a Vault that is up — she will flip you away, proc a Harrier mark on landing, and walk back to safety. Doran's Shield and Second Wind are mandatory; without them the chip damage adds up to a kill before level 6.

edits.before: Level 6 is your lane-phase lifeline but it does not flip the lane — it ends the slow bleed and opens one decisive play per trade cycle. The moment Quinn steps past the river threshold or moves toward a plate without her Vault charged, throw Glacial Prison through the wave. If it lands she is stunned in a blizzard, and you follow with Q knock-up into W double-strike into E Permafrost shatter — a four-hit CC chain she cannot survive. Track her Vault cooldown (roughly 11 seconds at rank one) and only commit your Q when it is clearly down. If she uses Vault to poke and vault back, let her — the cooldown clock is running and your next window is clean.
edits.after: Level 6 is your lane-phase lifeline but it does not flip the lane — it ends the slow bleed and opens one decisive play per trade cycle. The moment Quinn steps past the river threshold or moves toward a plate without her Vault charged, throw Glacial Prison through the wave. If it lands she is stunned in a blizzard, and you follow with Q knock-up into W double-strike into E Permafrost shatter — a four-hit CC chain she cannot survive. Vault is 12 seconds at rank 1 and its dash interrupts your charge, so commit Q only when it is clearly down. Behind Enemy Lines is a channel: your stun cancels it outright, so punish the takeoff rather than watching it.

edits.before: Two tank items means Quinn's poke pattern simply stops working against you — your Permafrost passive resistances after a clean wave absorb her auto-attack burst, and one R landing anywhere near her is a death sentence she cannot escape without Flash. The lane stat line probably shows you down in CS and plates, but none of that matters: your win condition was never the lane, it was being an unkillable CC machine in the teamfights around Dragon and Baron. Anchor every objective fight, keep Glacial Prison for their carry, and trust that a 60-percent-win matchup plays out in the macro even when the lane itself was miserable.
edits.after: Two tank items means Quinn's poke pattern simply stops working against you — Fury of the North's Frost Armor after a clean wave absorbs her auto-attack burst, and one R landing anywhere near her is a death sentence she cannot escape without Flash. Blinding Assault blanks basic attacks only, so Winter's Wrath keeps stacking Frost straight through it. The lane stat line probably shows you down in CS and plates, but none of that matters: your win condition was never the lane, it was being an unkillable CC machine in the teamfights around Dragon and Baron. Anchor every objective fight and hold Glacial Prison for their carry.

edits.before: - Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind): matchup-defining — Blind + disengage in one button — fight while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your Q dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Quinn Vault: 12s at rank 1 — a dash that briefly interrupts your charge, not a blind. The blind is Blinding Assault on 11s and it only blanks autos, never Winter's Wrath. - Behind Enemy Lines is a channel your stun cancels.

notes: Systematic naming defect: the blind is attributed to Vault everywhere, including the full layer's generated ability label 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' which appears in winCon, enemyWin, loading, phases[3].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding and several report entries. I corrected the prose and breakdown.cooldowns; the remaining 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' occurrences come from a generated label and should be fixed at the generator rather than string by string — flagging rather than editing each. The real mechanics: Vault dashes, damages, slows and briefly interrupts (that interrupt is what cancels Arctic Assault); Blinding Assault (Q, 11s) is the blind and it stops basic attacks only, so Winter's Wrath still stacks Frost through it. Behind Enemy Lines is a channel your CC cancels — previously absent. Also fixed: 'roughly 11 seconds at rank one' for Vault (it is 12), and 'a 60-percent-win matchup' in late while the file stores 43.55%. Packet/file win-rate conflict for the user: packet says 60% over 50 games, file says 43.55% over 124 games; the level chart agrees with the file. No win-rate field changed.
